meta.title: Clozer · Know who reads your documents, follow up at the right time
meta.description: Quotes, invoices, decks, technical docs: send a tracked link instead of an attachment. Clozer sees which pages get read, tells you who to follow up with, and writes the follow-up.
meta.shortDescription: Quotes, invoices, decks: send a tracked link. Clozer tells you who to follow up with and writes the follow-up.
meta.ogHeadline: See where your document heats up.

reading.name: Proposal “E-commerce site redesign”
reading.caption: Example: a reading of the “E-commerce site redesign” proposal. The most-read page is “Pricing”, 3:38.

hero.title: Know who's reading your proposal. Follow up <hot>at the right time</hot>.
hero.lead: For B2B sales reps and their managers. Send a Clozer link instead of the PDF: see who opens it, what they read and who they forward it to. Clozer drafts the follow-up.

silence.title: You hit send. Then, silence.
silence.body: The document is out. Did they open it? Forward it to the decision-maker? So you follow up blind: too early and you're a pest, too late and they've signed with someone else.

table.caption: What you know after sending: with a PDF attachment, and with a Clozer link (example values).

reply.label: Can they reply?
reply.pdf: By email, if they think of it
reply.link: They approve or book a call in the document

steps.title: Three steps. Nothing to install to get started.

upload.title: Drop your proposal.
upload.body: A PDF, a web page (Notion, Google Slides, Figma…) or a 3-minute video pitch.
upload.alt: Clozer screen: the area to drop a PDF, and the field to paste a web page link.

send.title: Send the link.
send.body: Paste it into your email, or let the Gmail and Outlook extension swap the attachment. One link per prospect.
send.alt: Clozer screen: the link is ready for Sarah Collins, with Copy link and Send by email buttons.

followUp.title: Approve the follow-up.
followUp.body: Clozer writes it and suggests the time. You read it, you send it.
followUp.alt: Clozer screen: a follow-up written after a pricing read, suggested for 9 AM the next day, waiting for Approve.

steps.guided: After you sign up, a guided tour walks you through a first test link.

followUps.title: Clozer drafts the <nowrap>follow-up</nowrap>. You approve it.
followUps.body: Every morning, the list of prospects to follow up with. For each one, a message based on what they read.

brief.title: The morning brief
brief.body: An email every working day, at the hour you choose: who to follow up with and which links are about to expire.

stuck.title: A follow-up that answers what's holding them back
stuck.body: The message starts from what the prospect read and from your offer. It lands on a working day, during office hours, in the prospect's time zone.

approve.title: Approved in one click, or sent on its own
approve.body: Switch to automatic mode and simple follow-ups go out without you, like a reminder or an offer to talk.

delicate.title: Delicate cases wait for you
delicate.body: A prospect who wrote to you, a reader who came through a forward, a link never opened. Their follow-up waits for your approval, even in automatic mode.

followUps.alt: Clozer's Today board: 2 hot prospects, Northwind and Acme, each with a follow-up ready to approve, and Atelier Morel, warm.

prospect.title: Your prospect moves forward without waiting on you.
prospect.body: It all happens inside the document. They approve, ask for a change or book a call, and you hear about it right away.

approve.title: Approve or ask for a change
approve.body: “Accept & sign” sits at the end of the document. If they want something changed, they write it right there in the document.

book.title: Book a call
book.body: Your Calendly or Cal.com page opens inside the document. As soon as they book, automatic follow-ups stop.

ask.title: Ask a question, or leave a voice note
ask.body: The assistant answers from your proposal and hands over to you when it doesn't know. On any page, the prospect can also leave a one-minute voice note, transcribed for you.

language.title: Read it in their language
language.body: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian or Portuguese: the PDF is translated with its layout intact.

prospect.actionsAlt: Proposal open on a phone, pricing page: at the bottom, Accept & sign, Book a meeting, Request a change, a voice note and forwarding; at the top, a choice of six languages.
prospect.changeAlt: The prospect asks for a change from inside the proposal: “Could we pay in three instalments? And start the design in November?”

channels.title: It works where you already send.
channels.body: Keep your inbox and your outreach tools. Clozer plugs into them.
channels.caption: Where to send a Clozer link, and how

web.name: Gmail and Outlook on the web
web.how: Attach the PDF as usual. The Chrome extension offers to swap it for a link in the recipient's name, then tells you when they read it.

outlook.name: Outlook desktop
outlook.how: On Windows and Mac, your Microsoft 365 admin adds the add-in for the whole team. An attached PDF becomes a link the same way.

chat.name: WhatsApp, LinkedIn, SMS
chat.how: Copy the link and paste it into the conversation. It opens in the browser, on a phone or a computer.

cold.name: lemlist and cold email
cold.how: With Smart Link, one link goes in your sequence. Every prospect who clicks is recognized and tracked, no form.

channels.storeNote: Free, for Gmail and Outlook on the web.

trust.title: Tracking without snooping.
trust.body: Your prospects are your future customers. Heat comes from what they read, page by page.
trust.informed: The prospect is told, on the page, what you can see.
trust.discreet: Your follow-ups talk about the offer, never about what you saw.
trust.limit: Three follow-ups per contact per month, max, and never right after a read.
trust.unsubscribe: An unsubscribe link in every follow-up, and IP addresses are never stored in the clear.
trust.subprocessors: See our subprocessors and where your data lives

who.title: For the rep, and for the manager.
who.beta: Clozer is free during the beta, no card. If a paid plan comes, you'll hear about it first.

team.name: Team
team.who: SME sales teams with a manager.
team.body: Each rep follows their own prospects. The manager sees everything in the Team view: what's moving, what's slipping, and each rep's pipeline.

solo.name: Solo
solo.body: One link per client, follow-ups written for you. Sign in with Google or your email.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.body: Security or integration needs? We look at your case together.

who.teamAlt: Clozer's Team view: 7 open deals, 4 moving, a €141,200 pipeline, broken down for Léa Fontaine, Hugo Mercier and Sophie Noël.

email.q: Does the prospect have to enter their email to read?
email.a: No. A link made for one prospect opens right away, with nothing to fill in. A link shared with several people, like a brochure, asks for the email so you know who's reading. With Smart Link, the address comes from your emailing tool. You can also ask for the email link by link.

informed.q: Does the prospect know their reading is tracked?
informed.a: Yes. A clear notice sits on the document page, with a link to our privacy policy. Follow-ups never mention a specific page or reading time.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Sign in with Google or your email, no password, and your prospect reads in their browser. The Gmail and Outlook extension is an optional shortcut.

tools.q: Does it work with my tools (Gmail, Outlook, lemlist, CRM)?
tools.a: Gmail and Outlook on the web with the Chrome extension, desktop Outlook with the Microsoft 365 add-in, lemlist and cold email with Smart Link. There's no native CRM integration: a webhook sends your alerts to the address of your choice.

auto.q: Do follow-ups go out on their own?
auto.a: By default, Clozer writes the follow-up and suggests the day and time to send it; you review it and approve in one click. Later on, you can let it send the simple ones by itself when it's confident. The tricky cases (an objection, a question from the prospect) always wait for you.

beta.a: Prices aren't set yet. You'll hear about any paid plan before it starts.

data.a: Our subprocessors, with the country of each, are listed on the <subprocessors>Subprocessors</subprocessors> page. What we collect and why is in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

home.final: Send your next proposal as a tracked link.

reading.title: See who reads what, and who else.
reading.body: Clozer logs every page read and the time spent on it. When the proposal goes around the buyer's team, every new reader shows up.

pages.title: Page by page
pages.body: How far they got, and which page they stopped on.

readers.title: Who else reads
readers.body: Each new reader's name or email, and the pages they read.

live.title: An alert when they read
live.body: In Chrome, at the top of Gmail and Outlook, or in Slack.

score.title: A temperature that explains itself
score.body: A score out of 100, every point with its reason.
